identification: Alcock & Co. wall-mounted billiards scoreboard, c.1880s-1910s (pre Alcock, Thomson & Taylor), 34 x 98 cm, moulded frame, plain straight-grain timber (looks like plain blackwood or similar; NOT fiddleback), two tracks (0-20 units, and 0-100 x2 hundreds strips) on printed paper strips, 4 turned timber sliding markers visible (one red ball marker per track plus small markers). Original oval black-and-gilt maker's label.
